tuples.subject: apr_disclosure
tuples.quote: 74.2 HFCs shall transparently disclose to the borrower all information about fees/ charges payable for processing the loan application, the amount of fees refundable if loan amount is not sanctioned/ disbursed, pre-payment options and charges, if any, the amount of penal charges for delayed repayment, if any, fees refundable if loan conversion charges for switching loan from fixed to floating rates or vice-versa, existence of any interest reset clause and any other matter which affects the options and charges, if any, penal interest/ penalty for delayed in processing/ sanctioning of loan application in a transparent manner.
